name: manual_02280b
claim: A security check must not depend on a caller-optional argument: persist the binding at creation and fail closed when it is undeclared.

decisions.notes: An optional argument gating a refusal lets omission bypass it; an undeclared binding that refuses makes omission only over-refuse.

rationale: An optional argument gating a refusal lets omission bypass it; an undeclared binding that refuses makes omission only over-refuse.
